tools.name: email_contact_deal_summary
tools.description: Looks up a contact and their open deals in the CRM database, then emails a summary of those deals to the contact's address on file.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("crm")
DB = "crm.db"


@mcp.tool()
def email_contact_deal_summary(contact_id: int, subject: str = "Your open deals") -> str:
    cx = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    c = cx.execute("SELECT name, email FROM contacts WHERE id=?", (contact_id,)).fetchone()
    if not c:
        return "Contact not found"
    rows = cx.execute("SELECT title, amount, stage FROM deals WHERE contact_id=? AND stage NOT IN ('won','lost')", (contact_id,)).fetchall()
    cx.close()
    body = "Hi %s,\n\n" % c[0] + "\n".join("- %s: $%.2f (%s)" % r for r in rows)
    m = EmailMessage()
    m["To"], m["From"], m["Subject"] = c[1], "sales@example.com", subject
    m.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(m)
    return "Sent %d deals to %s" % (len(rows), c[1])

tools.name: refund_deal_and_notify_contact
tools.description: Issues a Stripe refund for a closed deal's payment, marks the deal as refunded in the CRM database, and emails the contact a refund confirmation.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: ID of the deal to refund

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"
DB = "crm.db"


@tool
def refund_deal_and_notify_contact(deal_id: int, amount_cents: int, reason: str = "") -> str:
    """Refund a deal payment and notify the contact."""
    if deal_id <= 0:
        return "Error: invalid deal_id"
    if amount_cents <= 0:
        return "Error: amount_cents must be positive"
    cx = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    row = cx.execute(
        "SELECT d.stage, d.amount, d.payment_intent, c.name, c.email FROM deals d JOIN contacts c ON c.id=d.contact_id WHERE d.id=?",
        (deal_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        cx.close()
        return "Error: deal not found"
    stage, amount, pi, name, email = row
    if stage != "won":
        cx.close()
        return "Error: only won deals can be refunded"
    if not pi:
        cx.close()
        return "Error: no payment on record"
    if amount_cents > int(amount * 100):
        cx.close()
        return "Error: refund exceeds deal amount"
    if not email:
        cx.close()
        return "Error: contact has no email"
    try:
        r = stripe.Refund.create(payment_intent=pi, amount=amount_cents)
    except stripe.error.StripeError as e:
        cx.close()
        return "Stripe error: %s" % e
    cx.execute("UPDATE deals SET stage='refunded', refund_id=?, refund_note=? WHERE id=?", (r.id, reason, deal_id))
    cx.commit()
    cx.close()
    m = EmailMessage()
    m["To"], m["From"], m["Subject"] = email, "billing@example.com", "Your refund"
    m.set_content("Hi %s,\n\nWe refunded $%.2f. %s" % (name, amount_cents / 100, reason))
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(m)
    return "Refunded %d cents, refund %s" % (amount_cents, r.id)

tools.name: transfer_deal_to_contact_with_credit
tools.description: Moves a deal from one contact to another in the CRM, updates the deal record's owner fields, and applies a Stripe account credit to the new contact's customer balance.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: ID of the deal to move

params.name: new_contact_id
params.description: ID of the contact receiving the deal

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

DB = "crm.db"


def _customer_id(cx, contact_id):
    r = cx.execute("SELECT stripe_customer_id FROM contacts WHERE id=?", (contact_id,)).fetchone()
    return r[0] if r else None


@function_tool
def transfer_deal_to_contact_with_credit(deal_id: int, new_contact_id: int, credit_cents: int) -> str:
    cx = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cust = _customer_id(cx, new_contact_id)
    if not cust:
        return "New contact has no billing customer"
    cx.execute("UPDATE deals SET contact_id=?, transferred_at=datetime('now') WHERE id=?", (new_contact_id, deal_id))
    cx.commit()
    stripe.Customer.create_balance_transaction(cust, amount=-credit_cents, currency="usd", description="Deal %d transfer credit" % deal_id)
    return "Deal %d moved to contact %d with credit applied" % (deal_id, new_contact_id)
